dataset_preprocessing.details: Full preprocessing pipeline implemented and ran; scaler fit on train only (no leakage); stratified split test_size=0.2 random_state=42; artifacts saved (scaler.pkl, feature_names.json, label_mapping.json, constant_features.json); processed arrays saved (X_train 2,017,889x70, X_test 504,473x70). Raw data untracked in git; no validation scripts or dataset manifest.

centralized_ml.details: MLPIDS fixed (nn.Module inheritance at src/models/mlp.py:38); architecture 128-64-32, dropout 0.3, batchnorm; trained 20 epochs batch_size=256 Adam lr=0.001 BCEWithLogitsLoss. Model + results JSON saved. Metrics verified from JSON: accuracy 0.9771, precision 0.9616, recall 0.9001, f1 0.9298, roc_auc 0.9981, fpr 0.0073, fnr 0.0999. CPU-only; no hyperparameter tuning, no cross-validation, no early stopping.

federated_learning.details: Manual FedAvg (no Ray/Flower) ran 50 rounds to completion; 5 clients, non-IID Dirichlet alpha=0.5, local_epochs=5, batch_size=128, lr=0.001, warm start from centralized_mlp.pth, weighted aggregation by sample count, checkpoints every 10 rounds. Final model + results JSON saved. Metrics verified from JSON: accuracy 0.9587, precision 0.8818, recall 0.8721, f1 0.8770, fpr 0.0237, fnr 0.1279. Flower server/client and Ray path not executed (sandbox port binding blocked). Final federated metrics omit ROC-AUC.

differential_privacy.details: src/privacy/ directory empty. No DP-SGD, gradient clipping/noise, epsilon/delta accounting, or secure aggregation. PROJECT_SYNOPSIS.md claim that DP/secure aggregation were implemented is false.

evaluation_testing.details: src/evaluation/ directory empty. No unit tests, integration tests, or test harness. Model evidence exists only as persisted results JSONs, not executable tests. No independent validation harness or threshold-sensitivity analysis.

documentation_reproducibility.details: Code carries docstrings; PROJECT_SYNOPSIS.md and results JSONs/checkpoints exist. But PROJECT_SYNOPSIS.md contains false claims (Random Forest/XGBoost trained; differential privacy implemented) and cites the 5-round test (80% acc) instead of the completed 50-round run (95.9%). No root README, no run/reproduce instructions, no experiment-config documentation.

federated_5_round_test_small_subset.note: Small test subset; cited in PROJECT_SYNOPSIS.md but not representative of the full 50-round run
